# KidBookMaker: full description

> KidBookMaker turns a child's own story into a real, fully illustrated picture book starring them. Bring your book to life in minutes: tell the story, and KidBookMaker illustrates every page, emails a preview to perfect, and prints a real hardcover you'll keep forever.

Website: https://kidbookmaker.com/ (English) and https://kidbookmaker.com/es/ (Spanish)
Contact: kidbookmaker@mail.tab.bot

## What it is
KidBookMaker makes personalized children's picture books from the child's own story. It is not a template where only the name changes, and it is not a do-it-yourself book builder: the family does not draw, design, or lay out pages. They send the story (typed, recorded as a voice note, or uploaded as a file) and, optionally, up to 3 photos, for example the child or the people they would like in the book. KidBookMaker writes the story into pages, illustrates every scene with care in a consistent storybook style, keeps the child's words and ideas at the heart of it, and lays it out as a real picture book.

## Who it is for
Parents, grandparents, and families who want a one-of-a-kind book made from a child's imagination: a bedtime story the child invented, a story about a pet, a new sibling, a move, a favorite sport, or any adventure where the child is the hero. It makes a meaningful gift.

## How it works
1. Tell us the story. Type it, record it, or upload it, plus up to 3 photos if you like. A one-liner is plenty; a whole notebook is great too. Only the story and an email address are needed.
2. We illustrate it. We write it into pages, paint every scene, and email you a preview. Tweak anything: words, pictures, colors, even what the hero looks like.
3. Hold the real book. Approve it and we print a real hardcover. Pricing is shown with your preview.

## Examples from the site
- Age 4, "A dragon who's scared of the dark." became "Ember and the Dark": "Ember puffed one tiny flame, and the whole cave glowed like a nightlight."
- Age 7, "My cat Pickles builds a rocket to find out if the moon is made of cheese." became "Pickles Goes to the Moon": "The moon smelled a teeny bit like cheese. Pickles took one nibble, just to check."

## Frequently asked questions
### Who makes the book?
Your child writes the story. We turn it into pages, illustrate every scene, and lay it out as a real picture book, keeping their words and ideas at the heart of it.

### Is it really personalized?
Yes, from the first page to the last. It isn't a template with a name dropped in: the book is built from your child's own story, and if you add a photo, the hero in the pictures is drawn to look like them.

### What photos do I need?
None are required. You can add up to 3 photos (up to 20 MB each), for example the child or the people you'd like in the book. Clear, well-lit photos where faces are easy to see work best.

### How long does it take?
Your part takes a few minutes: type, record, or upload the story and press send. No drawing, no design software, no templates. Your first preview usually arrives within a few days. Printing and shipping come after you approve.

### Can I print it?
Yes. Every book is made to be printed. Once you approve the preview, we print a real hardcover.

### What languages can the book be in?
English or Spanish. Tell us the story in Spanish and the whole book will be in Spanish, and we'll write to you in Spanish too.

### What does it cost?
Books are priced per copy, and you'll see the price with your preview. There's nothing to pay until you approve the book.

### Can I change things?
Yes. Ask for as many tweaks as you want before printing: words, pictures, colors, even what the hero looks like. Just reply to our email.

## En español
KidBookMaker también hace libros infantiles personalizados totalmente en español: el texto, la portada, todo, y te escribimos en español. Cuéntanos la historia en español en https://kidbookmaker.com/es/ (escríbela, grábala o súbela, con hasta 3 fotos opcionales). Recibes una vista previa por correo para cambiar lo que quieras y, cuando la apruebas, imprimimos un libro de tapa dura de verdad. No pagas nada hasta que apruebes el libro; el precio se muestra junto con tu vista previa.

### Preguntas frecuentes
### ¿Quién hace el libro?
Tu hijo escribe la historia. Nosotros la convertimos en páginas, ilustramos cada escena y la maquetamos como un libro ilustrado de verdad, manteniendo sus palabras y sus ideas en el centro.

### ¿De verdad es personalizado?
Sí, de la primera a la última página. No es una plantilla a la que solo le cambiamos el nombre: el libro nace de la historia de tu hijo y, si agregas una foto, dibujamos al protagonista para que se parezca a él o a ella.

### ¿Qué fotos necesito?
Ninguna es obligatoria. Puedes agregar hasta 3 fotos (de hasta 20 MB cada una), por ejemplo del niño o de las personas que quieras en el libro. Funcionan mejor las fotos claras y con buena luz, donde se vean bien las caras.

### ¿Puede ser en español?
¡Claro! Cuéntanos la historia en español y haremos todo el libro en español: el texto, la portada, todo. Y te escribiremos en español.

### ¿Cuánto tarda?
Tu parte toma unos minutos: escribe, graba o sube la historia y envíala. Sin dibujar, sin programas de diseño, sin plantillas. La primera vista previa suele llegar en unos días. La impresión y el envío vienen después de que apruebes el libro.

### ¿Puedo imprimirlo?
Sí. Cada libro está hecho para imprimirse. Cuando apruebas la vista previa, imprimimos un libro de tapa dura de verdad.

### ¿Cuánto cuesta?
Los libros tienen un precio por ejemplar, y lo verás junto con tu vista previa. No pagas nada hasta que apruebes el libro.

### ¿Puedo cambiar cosas?
Sí. Pide todos los cambios que quieras antes de imprimir: palabras, ilustraciones, colores, incluso cómo se ve el protagonista. Solo responde a nuestro correo.
